column1: # Graphics-quality presets for an Unreal game, chosen in the settings window (DM_UE_QUALITY; dm/tools/ue_quality.py builds one replacement pak per preset, dm/host/hle_fs.c mounts it).
# The game reads its device-profile console variables from cooked .ini files in a pak at boot, so a preset is the same ini with edits, in a pak named <stem of the pak holding the ini>_99_P.pak
# beside that pak (Unreal mounts _P paks with priority). Columns, separated by tabs: preset (the setting's value; "off" has no rows), ini path in the pak, section (without brackets), key, value.
#   key = a console variable: the section's +CVars=<key>=<old> line is replaced, or +CVars=<key>=<value> is added at the end of the section
#   key = TextureLODGroups: value is Field=Value[,Field=Value...]; every +TextureLODGroups=(...) line of the section gets those fields replaced
#   a field written Old>New (MinMagFilter=linear>aniso) is replaced only where it is Old: the point-filtered groups (8- and 16-bit data, 2D pixels) stay point
# A row that matches no ini, no section, or (TextureLODGroups) no line stops the build. Handheld (the Switch DeviceProfile) keeps the Switch values; only SwitchConsole changes resolution.
